description: Curated research topics for enterprise AI adoption — Business + AI intersection

topics.title: LLM Governance Frameworks in Fortune 500 Organizations
topics.question: What organizational structures and governance frameworks best support responsible LLM adoption in Fortune 500 enterprises?
query_expansions: large language model enterprise deployment governance
topics.novelty_angle: Most governance frameworks are prescriptive; empirical evidence on which structures actually work is limited

topics.title: Measuring ROI from Enterprise AI Adoption: Frameworks and Evidence
topics.question: How do enterprises measure ROI from AI adoption and what organizational factors drive value creation?
topics.novelty_angle: ROI measurement in AI differs from traditional IT — probabilistic outcomes, long payback periods

topics.title: MLOps Maturity and Model Deployment Efficiency in Large Organizations
topics.question: How does MLOps maturity level affect model deployment efficiency and business value realization in large enterprises?
topics.novelty_angle: MLOps maturity models exist but quantitative links to business outcomes are sparse

topics.title: Data Governance Impact on LLM Deployment Quality in Enterprise Settings
topics.question: How does enterprise data governance maturity impact the quality and reliability of LLM deployments at scale?
topics.novelty_angle: LLM-specific data governance requirements differ fundamentally from traditional ML — training data provenance, RLHF quality

topics.title: Change Management Strategies for Successful Enterprise AI Adoption
topics.question: What change management strategies are most effective in driving successful AI adoption and minimizing resistance in large enterprises?
query_expansions: digital transformation change management large organization
topics.novelty_angle: AI-specific change management differs from ERP/CRM rollouts due to opacity and evolving capabilities

topics.title: AI Strategy Alignment and Competitive Positioning in Large Enterprises
topics.question: How do enterprises align AI strategy with corporate strategy to achieve sustainable competitive positioning?
topics.novelty_angle: Strategic alignment frameworks need updating for AI's distinctive characteristics (rapid depreciation, emergent capabilities)

topics.title: AI Talent Acquisition and Retention Challenges in Enterprise Organizations
topics.question: What talent acquisition and retention strategies are most effective for building AI capabilities in large enterprises?
query_expansions: AI talent acquisition enterprise data scientist
machine learning engineer retention large company
topics.novelty_angle: Competition for AI talent between tech startups and enterprises creates structural asymmetry rarely studied

topics.title: Federated Learning Adoption for Privacy-Preserving AI in Regulated Industries
topics.question: How are regulated industries (banking, healthcare, insurance) adopting federated learning to balance AI performance with privacy compliance?
query_expansions: distributed machine learning compliance healthcare finance
topics.novelty_angle: Federated learning literature is technical; business adoption barriers and governance models are underexplored
